ui_bugs.issue: Form does NOT close after successful save. Toast shows 'Programacion actualizada' but form remains visible.
ui_bugs.root_cause: In handleSave(), onRefresh() is called before onClose(). onRefresh() triggers fetchAuditDetail(selectedAudit) which re-renders the component with the same selectedAudit before onClose() can set it to null.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Programming edit form does not close after save
reproduction_steps: 2. Click on an audit to open programming edit form
4. Observe: Toast shows 'Programacion actualizada' but form remains visible
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In handleSave() at Audits.js line 299-313, onRefresh() is called before onClose(). onRefresh() triggers fetchAuditDetail(selectedAudit) which causes a re-render with the same selectedAudit value. By the time onClose() executes (which sets selectedAudit to null), the component has already re-rendered with the refreshed audit data, keeping the form visible.
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Option 1: Call onClose() before onRefresh(). Option 2: Use await on onRefresh() and ensure onClose() is called after. Option 3: Pass a flag to onRefresh to indicate form should close.
